title: CANopen
summary: CANopen is a higher-layer protocol on CAN with an object dictionary, process data objects (PDO) and service data objects (SDO).

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: Each node has a node ID and an object dictionary. PDOs carry real-time process data, SDOs access the dictionary, NMT controls the node state, heartbeat or node guarding monitor presence.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Bit rate mismatch, duplicate node IDs, missing termination (120 ohm at both ends) and error-passive or bus-off nodes.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
